title: Libra-Leaderboard: Towards Responsible AI through a Balanced Leaderboard of Safety and Capability

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses against standardized benchmark datasets (such as BBQ) using an automated evaluation framework (Libra-Eval) equipped with LLM-as-a-Judge and regex-based evaluators to detect discriminatory outputs.

Assessing large language models on stereotype-specific test sets (e.g., DecodingTrust Stereotype, Hypothesis Stereotypes) utilizing standardized prompt-based response collection and automated evaluators.
